title: Local inference call volume
description: Monthly local Ollama call counts, grouped by model label.
plainLanguageSummary: The local telemetry records completed and failed calls by month and model. It does not say whether an answer was useful or accepted.
howToRead: Compare call counts only within each model's local history. The recorded machine location is not available in the usage aggregate.

calculation.formula: Count Ollama usage records by calendar month and model label.
calculation.explanation: The aggregate omits prompts, responses, per-call times, IDs, endpoint names, and host information.
calculation.example: A value at date t uses only observations dated t or earlier unless the chart explicitly labels a visual shift.

patternsToWatch: Changes in monthly local call counts as more observations accumulate
limitations: A call is not necessarily a completed task or a useful result.
This is one local Ollama deployment, not a representative sample of Canada.
No server location or whole-system power is captured.

methodology.formula: Count Ollama usage records by calendar month and model label.
methodology.notes: The aggregate omits prompts, responses, per-call times, IDs, endpoint names, and host information.
